seed: Objects of type `arm` under action ACTION1 with touching neighbours [block,player] show mixed outcomes: y x2, no_change x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the presence, type or relative position of a neighbouring object. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring (player) A1/A2 moves y +-6 carrying blocks on the beam; beam (arm) A4/A3 w +-6, tag-free hook at tip-4 drags fully-on-beam blocks, unhooked extend pushes the swept strip.
Hypothesis arm A1 [block,player] no_change: carried/pushed blocks would leave the colour-4 field (field top), so the whole vertical move cancels; no neighbour type decides it.
Blocked horizontal chains: beam changes alone. Tags: hooked next -> collected, collected off beam reverts; legend swatch centre 0 while collected.
Render: erase objects with bg (field 4 / rail 2-3 period 6 / 5), draw ring, beam, blocks. HUD row: 3s=(n-1)//3, n=non-click actions, memo keyed by returned frames.
Open: HUD phase is hidden state (stateless fallback 3*bars+1); clicks are no-ops.
